material expression samples cropped source and typed uniforms through production Metal
material show time, render size and negative GLSL modulo have independent numeric pixels
ISF normalized coordinates and image reads preserve y-up semantics without changing native UV
invalid material source retains accepted shader/cache and exact last-good pixels
chroma/luma key, softness, spill, saturation, inversion and posterization match independent CPU values before tint
accepted material executes normal/add/multiply/screen blend variants with premultiplied pixel oracles
isolated group opacity applies once to composition while default groups preserve per-layer alpha
isolated group normal/add/multiply/screen modes blend the composed item with its background
nested isolated groups preserve transparent intermediate alpha and inherited visibility
group FX key the composed color after isolation, rather than independently keying child layers
group-local masks stay in group scope and global masks attenuate the complete composition
projective group-local mask inverse horizon preserves every unrelated backdrop pixel
multiple mask intersection and inverted holes reveal underlying layers without masking them
Bezier ellipse mask coverage and derivative antialias agree with an independent analytic boundary
edge blend channel oracle and complementary simulated projector ramps sum to unity
Bezier output deformation preserves independent source crop under an analytic inverse oracle
regular input mesh follows stroke arc/across UV after crop, independently from geometric cage UV
Bezier source warp follows stroke arc/across UV after crop, within half-texel/UNORM tolerance
self-loopback reads one completed prior generation and drops input while GPU work is pending
two-route feedback cycles share one immutable previous generation independent of route order
feedback reset suppresses stale GPU completion and permits a new generation
invalid feedback topology cancels publication; blackout is a new black generation
feedback retains at most four leased generations and resumes after consumers release them
feedback rejects negative/zero/overflow dimensions before allocation and recovers atomically
outputMeaning: Offscreen logical routes only; no physical displays.
scope: Actual Metal composition, bounded expression/ISF/FX, scoped masks, group isolation, edge attenuation and previous-generation loopback; original procedural sources only.
unmeasured: Physical devices, optical seams/refresh, throughput, long-run stability, decoder/audio timing and GPU utilization.
